profile.headline: Web Designer | Front-End Developer | AI-Enhanced Design Workflow
profile.summary:
I’m a web designer with nearly 10 years of experience helping clients and agencies launch clean, high-performing WordPress and Shopify websites. I focus on building user-friendly, scalable digital experiences that support real business goals — from conversion and performance to long-term growth.

I work collaboratively from planning through launch, bringing clarity, strong UX thinking, and reliable execution to every project.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Work closely with clients to establish needs and pain points

Provide logo design, social media design, and company branding for clients

Carried out quality assurance tests to discover errors and optimize usability

Deliver fully responsive, cross-browser websites on deadline

Designed, built, and launched custom WordPress and Shopify websites for small businesses

Organized and maintained Shopify and WooCommerce stores to support ongoing growth

Performed troubleshooting and optimization on legacy WordPress websites

Built branding, visual design systems, and scalable website architecture
